annotations.title: Toward al the sainctes.
annotations.text: <mn>◦</mn> The Apostle sticketh not to say, Charitie and faith in Christ and al his Saincts, which our captious Aduersaries count in Catholike mens speaches and writings, very absurd, feining that in al such we make no difference betwixt the loue we beare to Christ, and the loue we owe to our neighbours: betwixt the trust or beleefe we haue in God, and that which we haue in his holy Saincts. Malice and contention doth so blinde al Heretikes.
